menu.basis: The chips were good and the salsa was homemade and delicious.

why: Sushi rolls like the Cherry Blossom and Salmon Lover come out fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented.

signatureDish.name: Signature Sushi Rolls
signatureDish.description: The Cherry Blossom, Salmon Lover, and Under the Sea rolls, all fresh, flavorful, and beautifully plated.
signatureDish.basis: We ordered the Cherry Blossom, Salmon Lover, and Under the Sea sushi rolls, and every single one was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented.

menu.name: Miso Soup
menu.description: A quick starter one reviewer flags as excellent.
menu.basis: I was thinking of some miso, (excellent BTW)

menu.name: Karaage
menu.description: Karaage praised as excellently done, though it runs on the salty side.
menu.basis: Ordered the karaage and although it was done excellently it was very salty.

why: The spicy pork lunch set comes with generous portions and well-seasoned japchae, plus a surprising seafood jeon.

signatureDish.name: Spicy Pork Lunch Set
signatureDish.description: A well put-together set with tasty sides and a generous portion of spicy pork.
signatureDish.basis: I ordered the spicy pork lunch set here. The side dishes were tasty, and the set itself was well put together.

menu.name: Japchae
menu.description: Well-seasoned glass noodles with a nice variety of ingredients.
menu.basis: It came with japchae, which was well-seasoned and had a nice variety of ingredients.

menu.name: Seafood Jeon
menu.description: A well-fried seafood pancake loaded with seafood and a balanced sauce.
menu.basis: Seafood jeon is a surprise, well fried, containing lots of seafood, with well balanced sauce.

menu.name: Banchan
menu.description: Side dishes reviewers say complement the meal nicely.
menu.basis: The banchan were great and complemented the meal nicely.

why: The ube and earl grey wedding cake was called divine, and the Chocolate Dulce de Leche is rich but not heavy.

signatureDish.name: Ube & Earl Grey Cake
signatureDish.description: A divine, uniquely flavored wedding cake combining ube and earl grey.
signatureDish.basis: Their ube and early grey cake was divine, and everyone enjoyed the uniqueness of the flavors.

menu.name: Chocolate Dulce de Leche Cake
menu.description: A rich, flavorful, and moist cake paired often with the Vanilla Apricot flavor.
menu.basis: We ended up going with the Chocolate Dulce de Leche cake along with the Vanilla Apricot.

menu.name: Custom Birthday Cakes
menu.description: Personalized designs like a Thomas train and volcano cake that kids still remember.
menu.basis: My kid still remembers the Thomas train and Volcano cake that you made last year for his birthday.

why: The homemade sausage platter is a standout, and the grilled chicken pesto sandwich with sweet potato fries is a lively favorite.

signatureDish.name: Homemade Sausage Platter
signatureDish.description: A standout platter of two homemade sausages.
signatureDish.basis: The homemade sausage platter (2 pcs) is a standout

menu.name: Grilled Chicken Pesto Sandwich
menu.description: Grilled chicken with pesto and avocado, served with sweet potato fries.
menu.basis: I enjoyed their grilled chicken breast pesto sandwich with avocado & sweet potato fries!

menu.name: Laughing Monk 9th Gospel
menu.description: A well-liked craft beer on tap, best sipped carefully at 10% ABV.
menu.basis: I had the laughing monk 9th gospel which was very good.

why: A regular calls the plant-milk caramel latte the best hot drink they've had in years.

signatureDish.name: Caramel Latte
signatureDish.description: A plant-milk caramel latte one regular calls the best hot drink they've had in years.
signatureDish.basis: I tried caramel latte with plant milk more than once and I must say that’s the best hot drink I had in years.

menu.name: Tanzanian Peaberry Beans
menu.description: Rare single-origin beans a regular religiously buys.
menu.basis: I religiously buy their Tanzanian peaberry and Panama Highlands Catuai.

menu.name: Bagels
menu.description: Always fresh bagels paired with the coffee.
menu.basis: I love the coffee and Bagels always fresh and delicious
